items.title: Seed Box with a Ribbon-Tied Notebook
items.alt: A divided wooden box holds corn kernels, speckled beans and pale seeds beside kraft envelopes and a tied cream notebook.
items.description: Three wooden compartments separate yellow kernels, speckled beans and pale seeds. Blank envelopes and a cream notebook tied with red, black and green cord complete the small seed-saving gift.

items.title: Three Hands Joined Above a Woven Cloth
items.alt: Three adult hands with cream, teal and rust-patterned cuffs overlap above a small red, black and green woven cloth.
items.description: Three differently dressed arms meet in a stack of hands. Cream fabric, teal sleeves and a rust-patterned cuff provide distinct textures above a small striped woven cloth.

items.title: Rope-Laced Wooden Hand Drum
items.alt: A wooden goblet-shaped drum has a pale drumhead, red, black and green lacing and a striped carrying strap.
items.description: Rope lacing runs from a pale drumhead down the tapered wooden body. Carved geometric details mark the lower section, while a striped strap curves beside the complete drum.

items.title: Three Seated Percussion Players
items.alt: Three seated musicians play a goblet drum, a round shaker and a frame drum beneath red, black and green pennants.
items.description: A woman in a mustard dress plays a tall hand drum beside a gray-bearded musician holding a round shaker. A younger player in plum completes the group with a frame drum; each sits on a separate stool.

items.title: Reading Behind a Cloth-Draped Lectern
items.alt: A woman with long locs reads an open book behind a wooden lectern draped with striped cloth and fitted with a microphone.
items.description: An open book rests in the reader’s hands above a wooden lectern. Her cream blouse and long navy skirt contrast with the red, black and green drape, while an angled microphone points toward her.

items.title: Dancer with a Flowing Striped Sash
items.alt: A dancer in a teal top and flowing rust skirt extends her arms as a red, black and green sash trails beside her.
items.description: A long rust skirt sweeps around the dancer’s legs beneath a fitted teal top. Her raised arms and trailing striped sash create a wide, open silhouette, with black flats visible below the hem.
